construct.required: Use native airborne Glide for at least25m, actually land on the lower destination plinth within5m horizontal/1m vertical, then reach the shelter within3m/1m alive, grounded and still with an animal hide.
construct.distinctness: This is controlled descent and aerial landing, not S03's alternating-ledge ascent/rest/descent, S04's subterranean switchback navigation, or the mountain-workshop anchor's separated workstations and crafting. A walk into the plinth after landing elsewhere cannot satisfy the native glide-landing gate.
construct.meaningful_consequences: Native flight and falling continue during inference. Overshoot, premature deployment/stowing and bad approach can miss the plinth or lose health. No inference-time pause, flight assist, health protection, larger tolerance or synthetic landing was introduced.
construct.fairness: Both profiles publicly disclose that the plateau is north/ahead of initial facing and below the ridge, with shelter beyond the plinth. No coordinates or input timing are supplied. This is the only change from the guided reference task text; all fixture, budget, tool and scorer fields remain unchanged.
construct.not_claimed: No hidden-mechanism learning, route-search complexity, mandatory crafting or continuous-survival attribution.

difficulty.reason: A single aligned flight and short post-landing approach, with an explicit destination bearing and no inventory, dialogue, crafting or multi-branch route puzzle, is easier but substantive in both interfaces. The native VM witness needs only two predeclared keyboard batches and no camera turn. Native control feasibility is strong; the witness is not claimed to model inference latency.
difficulty.anchor: The published mountain_workshop_circuit ST2/VM4 combines multiple elevated stations, traversal, inventory/crafting/equipment interaction and return. This simpler aerial-control condition warrants2/2 rather than inheriting the anchor's hard VM rating or forcing3.
difficulty.trajectory_limit: Both unhinted finals failed. ST overshot during38.867s of active play including31.031s of inference; VM made164 tools without a qualifying glide landing. These reveal real control/termination weaknesses but neither failure proves the task is hard. Statistical confidence is low with one measurement per profile.
difficulty.policy: Accept this genuine easier case under the user's explicit difficulty flexibility; no invented quota or weakened success gate.

native_witnesses.boundary: Guided model-free witnesses are native feasibility evidence, not formal model success. Goal-only text reconciliation is explicitly recorded and does not permit fixture/scorer changes.
